description_en: Queries the details of a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instance
description_zh: 查询负载均衡实例详细信息
name: GetLoadBalancerAttribute

parameters.help_zh: 网关型负载均衡实例的ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

AddressIpVersion.description_en:
The protocol version. Valid values:

Ipv4: IPv4
AddressIpVersion.description_zh:
协议版本。取值：

Ipv4：Ipv4类型

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 资源创建时间，使用格林威治时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

LoadBalancerBusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the GWLB instance. Valid values:

Normal: running as expected
FinancialLocked: locked due to overdue payments
LoadBalancerBusinessStatus.description_zh:
网关型负载均衡的业务状态。取值：
Normal：正常状态。
FinancialLocked：欠费锁定状态

LoadBalancerId.description_zh: 网关型负载均衡实例的ID

LoadBalancerName.description_en:
The GWLB instance name.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter
LoadBalancerName.description_zh:
网关型负载均衡实例名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

LoadBalancerStatus.description_en:
The GWLB instance status. Valid values:

Active: The GWLB instance is running.
Inactive: The GWLB instance is disabled. Listeners of GWLB instances in the Inactive state do not forward traffic.
Provisioning: The GWLB instance is being created.
Configuring: The GWLB instance is being modified
LoadBalancerStatus.description_zh:
网关型负载均衡的实例状态。取值：
Active：运行中。
Inactive：已停止，表示实例监听不会再转发流量。
Provisioning：创建中。
Configuring：变配中

Key.description_en:
The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Key.description_zh:
标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

一个标签健最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`

Value.description_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Value.description_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

TrafficMode.description_en:
Traffic processing mode. Valid values:

LoadBalance: load balancing mode. GWLB forwards traffic to backend servers.
ByPass: bypass mode. GWLB directly returns traffic to the GWLB endpoint without forwarding it to the backend servers
TrafficMode.description_zh:
流量模式。取值：

LoadBalance：负载均衡。
ByPass：绕行模式

ZoneMappings.description_en: The mappings between zones and vSwitches. You must specify at least one zone. You can specify at most 20 zones. If the region supports two or more zones, specify at least two zones
ZoneMappings.description_zh: 可用区及交换机映射列表。至少需要添加一个可用区，最多支持添加20个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上的可用区，建议添加2个及以上可用区

items.description_en: The information about the zones and vSwitches
items.description_zh: 可用区及交换机映射对象

LoadBalancerAddresses.description_zh: 网关型负载均衡实例地址列表

items.description_en: The details about the GWLB instance addresses
items.description_zh: 网关型负载均衡实例地址对象

EniId.description_en: The ID of the elastic network interface (ENI) used by the GWLB instance

VSwitchId.description_en: The vSwitch in the zone. You can specify only one vSwitch (subnet) in each zone of a GWLB instance
VSwitchId.description_zh: 可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区只能使用一台交换机和一个子网
